producer.recipe: OpenSSL generates a disposable RSA-2048 identity; xmlsec1 signs the stored templates with explicit URI maps, then independently verifies each result. --store-references supplies exact digest-input bytes. Private material is discarded. URI context bases come from xmllint shell base; Python urllib.parse.urljoin independently resolves the recorded relative references.
